messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Re: Error message?
messages.body_plain:
Hi Tom,

I would start by checking with:

library(tcltk)

works in a clean session.  AFAIK with recent versions of R, you are not supposed to have to install separately (see: http://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/tools/) but I do not use a Mac.

If you cannot load and use the tcltk package itself, that will need to get debugged first.

Cheers,

Josh

messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Work with current R release / Mac OSX?
messages.subject_clean: [MplusAutomation] Work with current R release / Mac OSX?
messages.body_plain:
Hi Tom,

Yes, MplusAutomation does work on a Mac with the latest release of R; however, it requires the tcltk package.  See some additional answers and suggestions here:

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/24056670/unable-to-load-caret-package-in-r-on-r-3-1-0-on-osx-10-9

For some people, just reinstalling R seems to help.  You can also check whether you have X11 or XQuartz installed, and if not install those.

It may also be a permissions issue:

http://socserv.socsci.mcmaster.ca/jfox/Misc/Rcmdr/installation-notes.html

Or you may need some additional symlinks:

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/18550971/tcltk-library-issue-while-install-rcmdr-package-on-macbookpro

Basically the error is saying it cannot find X11 on your system, so that is what needs to get resolved.

Cheers,

Josh
